reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing market-analysis visualization tool for DeepSeek Harness that adds an interactive sidebar experience to render stock candlestick charts and related data. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows it supports natural-language queries, HK/US/A-share symbols, multiple indicators, support/resistance annotations, and news/basic information views, which indicates its main purpose is financial chart visualization and analysis rather than code generation or workflow orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏中提供面向港股、美股和A股的交互式K线行情分析，可用自然语言查看图表、技术指标及新闻基本面信息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an interactive DeepSeek Harness sidebar for stock analysis, letting users query market data in natural language and view candlestick charts, indicators, and related news/basic information for HK, US, and A-share symbols.

capabilities: Supports querying and displaying HK, US, and A-share market data in candlestick charts.
Displays interactive chart controls including zoom, drag, crosshair, timeframe, and period switching.
Shows technical indicators and marks support/resistance with touch counts.
Provides related news and basic company/fundamental context for queried symbols.
Integrates into a DeepSeek Harness sidebar interface for user-facing interaction.
